test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 10
subject: general
question: Which of the following cities is nicknamed as 'City of Joy' in India?
solution:
__
 
• **Kolkata **__is nicknamed as the City of Joy after the 1985 novel of the same name by Dominique Lapierre.
 
• Mumbai is called the "City of dreams".
 
• Nashik is also known as ‘Wine Capital of India’
 
• Jaisalmer is also known as the 'Golden City'.
 
• Silicon Valley of India is the nickname of Bengaluru.
